audience: office and facilities managers who run desk and meeting room bookings in Clearooms

useCases.title: Find a meeting room available at a set time
useCases.text: List the meeting rooms of an office for a day, with each room's availability. Check that a room can be booked at your times.

useCases.title: See who has a desk on a given day
useCases.text: List the desks of an office for a day with their availability. Then list the bookings for that day to see who holds each desk.

useCases.title: Review my desk bookings for the week
useCases.text: List your own bookings for a date range, or only the unconfirmed ones. Open one booking to read its times, desk and status.

useCases.title: Book a desk for several days
useCases.text: Check desk availability for the dates you need. Then book a desk for consecutive days or for specific slots.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking when plans change
useCases.text: List your bookings for the week, then cancel the one you no longer need. Cancelling also removes the bookings linked to it.

useCases.title: Build a bookings report for a month
useCases.text: Get every booking that starts or ends between two dates, for an office report. Both dates may be the same day.
